verdict.line: You lose if you walk into a point-blank Hookshot/Q combo near a wall before level 6; you win almost every fight where she has no wall to engage from.

brief.thesis: This is a dead-even matchup on the numbers (48.9% over 1390 games) because both champions are built to force the first commitment, but Volibear carries the solo-kill edge: Camille's entire engage and escape kit runs through E (Hookshot), which only works off a wall. Deny her terrain and she has nothing but a delayed Q (Precision Protocol) auto to poke with, while your Q (Thundering Smash) stun into double W (Frenzied Maul) punishes any extended trade.

theirWindow.when: She's near a wall from level 2 on
theirWindow.what: Expect Hookshot's knockup chained into an empowered Q (Precision Protocol) auto. Back off or pre-emptively zone her away from the wall rather than standing in E range (800) while she's adjacent to terrain.

yourWindow.when: Her E or Q recast is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Walk her down and force the fight: stun with Q (Thundering Smash), mark with W (Frenzied Maul), then recast W immediately for the bonus damage and self-heal before Precision Protocol's move speed lets her reset the trade.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: The health and mana regen keep you spamming Frenzied Maul for poke and sustain through Camille's early Tactical Sweep harass without running dry.

boots.why: Camille's damage is entirely physical (her auto-attacks, Q, and on-hit procs), so the flat damage reduction directly blunts her empowered-auto trades.

core.why: The ability haste shortens Q and E cooldowns for more frequent stuns and shields while feeding the Lethal Tempo attack speed stack.
Crit refunds ability haste, looping Q (Thundering Smash) and E (Sky Splitter) back up faster so you out-trade Camille's lower-cooldown kit.
The healing amp stacks with W's self-heal on recast, and the magic resist eats into Camille's R bonus magic damage on her autos.

you want extra sustain and burst for skirmishes around objectives
the game runs long and you need omnivamp to win extended fights
you're snowballing ahead and need wave clear speed to split push

runes.keystoneWhy: The stacking attack speed rewards staying in extended trades and recasting W (Frenzied Maul), which is exactly the fight Camille loses without her wall.

summoners.why: Ignite converts your solo-kill advantage into actual kills by cutting through Camille's Tactical Sweep healing once you land your stun-into-mark combo.

playing.title: Poke from brush with E
playing.detail: Sky Splitter has 1200 range, so cast it from inside a brush to land the slow and damage without revealing your position or giving Camille a clean read on your cooldown.

playing.title: Punish her away from walls
playing.detail: Hookshot requires a wall target to function at all. If Camille roams or trades without terrain nearby, she has no gap-close or escape — all-in immediately with Q (Thundering Smash).

playing.title: Dump your combo when she commits
playing.detail: Once she steps inside W range (325), stun with Q, mark with W, then immediately recast W for the bonus damage and heal before Precision Protocol's move speed lets her disengage.

playing.title: Respect her Q recast window
playing.detail: Precision Protocol's delayed recast hits far harder than the initial proc. If she's holding the recast, don't trade into it — wait for it to expire or whiff.

playing.title: Step through Tactical Sweep, don't back into it
playing.detail: The outer half of her cone slows and deals extra damage while healing her. Walking toward her during the cast delay minimizes how much of the cone you eat.

playing.title: Save R for towers and picks
playing.detail: Stormbringer's cooldown is far too long to use as a lane combo piece. Hold it from level 6 onward to disable a tower on a dive or close distance on a roam elsewhere.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win rates are pulled directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the matchup reasoning — wall dependency, trade timing, and combo order — is my own tactical read, not measured data.
